b: Lowe’s has included this Jorgensen construction jack in their deals of the day.
They priced it down to $55, which they say saves you $25.
It looks to be a standard-type lifting jack, with spreader mode and micro-adjust.
The deal is valid today only, ending at 3am ET 11/19/26 unless supplies sell out sooner.
It looks like they’re fulfilling from local store inventory, but from what I’m seeing there’s free delivery. You can also opt for in-store pickup.

Amazon has the 2-pack for $140, and individual jacks for $90 each, although their design is a little different. It looks like the Lowe’s model has additional features, such as the foot pad and spreading mode.
Interestingly, the bottom foot can also be reversed for clamping mode.
